up: Return the exact activity values and structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649943. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, the standard type (e.g., IC50), the standard value, the standard units, the standard relation (e.g., '=), and the activity comment.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.activity_comment
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649943';
